build_EvoformerIteration: build a python module to run one iteration of the Evoformer stack updating MSA and pair activations
create_TriangleMultiplication: create a python module to compute outgoing or incoming triangle multiplication on pair representations
run_Attention: run a python module to compute multihead attention with optional gating on query and memory tensors
build_DistogramHead: build a python module to predict distogram logits from pair representations for distance bin classification
compute_softmax_cross_entropy: compute softmax cross entropy loss given logits and one-hot encoded class labels
